checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on placeholder elements — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a list container with role=list

RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-01.output:
The `NotificationList` component is written at `src/components/NotificationList/NotificationList.tsx` with its colocated CSS.

Key decisions:
- **Loading state**: 4 `<li>` elements inside `<ul role="list">` with no `aria-hidden` — they participate in the accessible tree so `getByRole` queries work correctly.
- **Placeholder animation**: uses only `opacity` (allowed by constraint: "animate only `transform` and `opacity`"), with `@keyframes` inside the `@layer components` block.
- **Tokens**: all visual values use `--shelf-notificationList-*` component-tier tokens (bgColor, fgColor, etc.) — these need corresponding entries in `tokens.css` before the CSS will fully resolve, but the component itself is correct per the constraints.
- **No `aria-hidden`**: placeholder `<li>` elements are real list items so role queries see them.
